# RealisticDeviceModeling

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
Incorporating physical imperfections such as disorder, finite temperature, and coupling variations into theoretical models of topological devices. Bridges the gap between idealized topological predictions and experimental reality, essential for translating TCC concepts into working hardware.
